H2.rule: check Spearman > flips Spearman in every condition

H3.rule: label-free option chosen by the check within 0.25 pp of the best label-free option in every condition

H4.rule: check penalty above the true penalty in at least 95% of candidate-condition pairs

H5.rule: secondary: check from the default simulator vs true penalty in each perturbed simulator, Spearman >= 0.70
